case_name: Younge v. Fulton Judicial Circuit District Attorney’s Office
title: Title VII
status: historical trial design, not approval or source evidence

cue.heading: Title VII
cue.text: Title VII does not cover people an elected official chooses for their personal staff. Assuming the test applies, the Eleventh Circuit weighed six factors: the official’s power to hire and fire; accountability to the official alone; representing the official to the public; the official’s control over the position; its rank; and how closely the two actually work.
cue.source: 42 U.S.C. § 2000e(f) · Eleventh Circuit opinion, Pet. App. 15a–16a
